notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q562053_uss_oriskany.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Upright on the sand at about 65 m, bow to the south: the hurricane bow, the hangar, the angled flight deck with its lifts, the island with the stack and mast rising to about 26 m; no armament (removed before scuttling); an artificial reef. The layout of the island and of the lifts is approximate. model_built.glb: the carrier as she was when decommissioned. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
